=== NIGHT 1: THE LAWS REWRITE THEMSELVES ===
Midnight strikes. The statutes of the metropolis dissolve and reform. The ground shifts, doors groan, and the air hums with new legal force. All written documents now bear different laws.
================================================
The path to courtroom seals shut under tonight's new statutes.
The new statutes alter the fighting doctrine of the metropolis. Enemy combat behaviors have shifted tonight.
I leveled up 1 times!
